time_token.charted_block_effect: an owned type-7 row like the latent rows: chart_in reads it, the block attends to it, and the block delta is written back to it (as the parent updates row 0)
time_token.installer_check: none: c16 1.2.0 loads modulation-none containers without a time gate; this row is a runtime layout contract (R3 host rows + the S7 driver must emit it)
time_token.layout: each volume segment = [1 time-token row | latent rows], all type_id 7, contiguous, time row FIRST
time_token.pairing: R3 pairs the time row trunk state with the parent block-10 INPUT row 0 (the evolved time token), not with t_embedder(t); the block-0 token is shipped only as a reference
time_token.reference: FP32 t_embedder(sigma) at sigma 0.00..1.00 step 0.05 = the block-0 time row; the block-10 row has evolved
time_token.time_row_feature: all zeros over native_feature_dim (no latent content)
time_token.time_row_noise_level: the segment sigma in [0, 1] (the same value as its latent rows): the bridge noise_proj is then the only content-bearing input of that row
time_token.time_row_position: thwr_v1 [-1, -1, -1, -1] (reserved: no latent row uses a negative coordinate)
time_token.what: the parent time token: HunYuanDiTPlain prepends t_embedder(t) as sequence row 0 (x = cat([t, x_embedder(latents)], dim=1)); every block self-attends over it and updates it
